questions.stem: What is the main reason lightning is dangerous?
choices: It has a very high temperature
questions.solution: Lightning is dangerous because it can reach extremely high temperatures, which can cause fires and serious burns. The other options, such as causing rain or creating wind, are not the primary reasons for its danger. Loud sounds, while disruptive, do not pose the same level of physical harm as extreme heat.

questions.stem: What is the correct way to protect yourself if you are caught in a storm?
choices: Take shelter in a pucca house
questions.solution: Taking shelter in a pucca house is safe during a storm because it provides solid protection from lightning and strong winds. Standing near a tall tree increases the risk of being struck by lightning, using a metal object can conduct electricity, and wearing wet clothes can increase the danger of electric shock if lightning strikes nearby.

questions.stem: What is the safest place to be during a thunderstorm?
questions.solution: A pucca house is the safest place during a thunderstorm because it provides protection from lightning. Being on a boat, under a tree, or on open ground increases the risk of being struck by lightning.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for a cloudburst to occur?
questions.solution: A cloudburst occurs primarily due to high temperatures near the land, which cause rainwater to evaporate before it reaches the ground. Drought, war, and uncontrolled population growth do not directly influence the formation of a cloudburst. The process is driven by atmospheric conditions, not human or environmental factors like drought or population.

hi.stem: एक बारिश के झोंके के होने का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
hi.solution: एक बारिश के झोंके के होने का मुख्य कारण भूमि के पास उच्च तापमान होता है, जो बारिश के पानी को जमीन तक पहुंचने से पहले वाष्पित कर देता है। शुष्कता, युद्ध और अनियंत्रित जनसंख्या वृद्धि बारिश के झोंके के निर्माण पर सीधा प्रभाव नहीं डालते हैं। प्रक्रिया वातावरणीय स्थितियों द्वारा निर्देशित होती है, न कि शुष्कता या जनसंख्या जैसे मानवीय या पर्यावरणीय कारकों द्वारा।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English content, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium educational context.

mr.stem: मुख्य कारण काय आहे ज्यामुळे ढगाळ वर्षाव होतो?
mr.solution: ढगाळ वर्षाव भूमी जवळ उच्च तापमानामुळे होतो, ज्यामुळे पाणी जमिनीवर पोहोचण्यापूर्वी वाफ होते. अकाल, युद्ध आणि अनियंत्रित लोकसंख्या वाढ ढगाळ वर्षाव तयार होण्यावर सीधा परिणाम करत नाहीत. प्रक्रिया वातावरणीय अवस्थांमुळे होते, जे मानवी किंवा पर्यावरणीय कारणांमुळे नाहीत.
